note: Same shape as qwen3.5-0.8b: 18 Gated-DeltaNet layers (symmetric key/value heads) + 6 full-attention layers. Only hidden (2048) and intermediate (6144) size scale up. NOT an official OE-LLM architecture; BLLM-native only. The vision half of the checkpoint is dropped for the text package (see the qwen3.5-vlm recipe for image+text).

quantisation.kept_fp32: SSM recurrence, depthwise conv, RMSNorms, GDN gated-norm
quantisation.note: Same data-free quantisation as qwen3.5-0.8b — flat int16 activation ranges fit at this size with no calibration set. (4B needs per-linear activation calibration; see the qwen3.5-4b recipe.)

toolchain.note: Recorded so a future regression can be attributed. Host toolchain and board HBRT must match.

measured.note: S100P, 2026-07-26, performance mode set (0x2b047000/0x2b047004 = 0x99, re-written and read back this session). Measured two ways: (1) hrt_model_exec perf directly on the decode .hbm, 30 frames, single thread, dedicated core; (2) chat() through the image+text package (same decode sub-graph as the text-only package), 3 repeated runs, decode_tok_s identical to 2 decimal places across all 3 (13.21, 13.22, 13.22). Board had another model's serving process stopped for the duration, restored afterward.

rejected_builds.name: block_quantized_matmul (dynamic-quant decode)
rejected_builds.why: Same failure as qwen3.5-0.8b: the dynamic per-token quant path is a PREFILL op, ~130x slower per matmul in decode than the static leap.linear path. Not independently re-measured at this size — the mechanism does not depend on model size.

rejected_builds.name: all-BPU chunked prefill (Newton triangular inverse)
rejected_builds.why: Same numerical failure as qwen3.5-0.8b: Newton doubling's 2I-AX transiently overshoots and int16 clips it on deep layers. Not size-dependent — see that recipe for the measured cosine collapse.

board_verification.flow: docker stop the resident serving container; bllm.load(dir) in isolation; hrt_model_exec perf on the decode graph directly + chat() (3 repeated runs); restore the stopped container
